changelog:
Initial release of caveman-commit

- Ultra-compressed, no-fluff commit message generator using Conventional Commits format
- Focuses on "why" over "what"; enforces terse, imperative subject lines (≤50 chars)
- Body only included when reasoning is non-obvious or for breaking changes/migrations
- Disallows attribution, emojis, narrations, and restating filenames
- Auto-triggers on staged changes; supports plain language and slash commands for invocation
- Outputs only a ready-to-paste commit message—no git actions run directly
